## 1. Executive Summary & Identity
Muhammad Haerul, S.Kom is an accomplished Indonesian Artificial Intelligence (AI) Full-Stack Specialist, Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI Researcher, and Technology Trainer. He graduated as the Most Outstanding Student (Mahasiswa Berprestasi) with a Bachelor of Computer Science from Universitas Hasanuddin (GPA 3.97 / 4.00, Cum Laude).

He specializes in:
- Applied Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
- Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Agentic AI Workflows
- Computer Vision (Object Detection, OCR, Facial & License Plate Recognition)
- Scalable Full-Stack Engineering (FastAPI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis)
- Technology Mentorship, Technical Training & Public Speaking

---

## 2. Key Academic & Professional Credentials
- **Formal Education**: Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Kom), Universitas Hasanuddin (2020 – 2024). Specialization in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science. GPA: 3.97/4.00, Cum Laude.
- **Academic Honors**: Most Outstanding Student (Mahasiswa Berprestasi) of Hasanuddin University; 1st Place National Level at DEXLLM AI Innovation; Best Graduate of Faculty of Informatics.
- **Leadership Roles**:
  - Co-Founder & Technical Lead at Aksarahub.id (Cultural preservation technology through OCR & AI).
  - AI Team Lead & Technical Mentor at RevoU.
  - Google Student Ambassador (GSA) alumni.
- **Certifications**: 22+ professional certifications including:
  - Machine Learning Specialization (DeepLearning.AI & Stanford University / Andrew Ng)
  - Machine Learning in Production - MLOps (DeepLearning.AI)
  - Generative AI with LangChain & HuggingFace (DeepLearning.AI)
  - Prompt Engineering for Software Developers (Vanderbilt University)
  - Deep Learning & Data Science Digital Talent Scholarship (Ministry of Communication & Informatics / Kominfo)
  - SQL & Python Verified Skill Certifications (HackerRank)

## 3. Notable AI Projects & Open Source
1. **Aksara Lontara Recognition & Galaxy Aksara**: AI system and mobile engine for optical character recognition of ancient Bugis/Makassar Lontara script.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/GEwjEfHMg-4
   - Web App: https://www.galaxyaksara.id/
2. **AI Chatbot - VectorRAG**: Enterprise conversational intelligence using vector embeddings, dense semantic retrieval, and local rerankers.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/6bJdURMwQbk
3. **Galaxy ALPR (Automatic License Plate Recognition)**: Real-time high-throughput computer vision pipeline for Indonesian vehicle license plates.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/CngIuDBNCLA
4. **PPE Inspector**: Automated Personal Protective Equipment computer vision detection system for industrial safety compliance.
   - Interactive App: https://ppe-inspector.streamlit.app/
   - Academic Paper: https://repository.unhas.ac.id/id/eprint/44411/
5. **AI Update Hub**: Automated AI research aggregator and summarizer built with modern LLM pipelines.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/AelUqjbJaG4
   - Web App: https://ai-update-hub.onrender.com/
6. **AI Split Bills**: Intelligent multi-item receipt parser and bill splitter utilizing multimodal vision LLMs.
   - Demo Video: https://youtube.com/shorts/qXtIyUeEuuw
   - Web App: https://ai-split-bills.vercel.app/
7. **galaxy-object-detection-core**: Official Python package published on PyPI for rapid computer vision object detection workflows.
   - PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/galaxy-object-detection-core/
8. **Eatitude.id**: Intelligent nutrition tracker and meal vision analyzer.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/wOsPg19O8KM
   - Web App: https://eatitude-id-web.vercel.app/
